objective: FICHE_STRATEGIE v1 id: trend_supertrend archetype: trend_supertrend family: trend timeframe: side: both indicators: - supertrend(atr_period=20, multiplier=3.0) - adx(period=18) - atr(period=14) entry: - long: supertrend.direction == 1 and adx.adx > 25 - short: supertrend.direction == -1 and adx.adx > 25 exit: - condition: direction_change(supertrend.direction) or adx.adx < 15 risk: stop_atr_mult: 1.25 tp_atr_mult: 4.5 description: ATR trailing stop (1.25x) and take-profit (4.5x) constraints: - no_lookahead: true - only_registry_indicators: true

iterations.hypothesis: Combining Supertrend with ADX creates a robust trend-following system that filters out weak trends and reduces whipsaws. The ADX filter ensures we only trade in strong trending conditions, while Supertrend provides dynamic support/resistance levels that adapt to volatility. This combination improves signal quality by confirming trend direction and strength before entering trades.

Alternative: switch to MACD + ATR filter with dynamic position sizing, or test RSI + Supertrend combination for better signal confirmation.
